models.name: EF7200DE
models.notes: Yamaha lists "Remote starter kit" for EF4000–EF7200; 32 ft wired kit 7VW-Y8720-A0-00 fits EF5200/6600

gotchas: Interlock: "the engine will not start unless both starter switch on the control panel and the engine switch on the remote control unit are switched on" (p.17) — panel key must stay ON.
Crank limits: starter cuts at 1,050 r/min; stops if no run in 3 s / 21 s (p.17).
Wiring diagram shows the connector with Blk and R leads only (p.46); kit-side schematic not published.
